title: Residue fields of points in scheme fibres
statement: For any morphism f:X -> S of schemes and x in X, view x as z=asFiber(x) in the fibre X_(f(x)). The arrow Spec kappa(z) -> Spec kappa(f(x)) obtained from the fibre structure map is isomorphic to Spec of the original residue-field map kappa(f(x)) -> kappa(x). The isomorphism on targets is the identity. Residue fields and scheme fibres use [def-pc-scheme-fibre] and [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions].

proof.text: The fibre inclusion is a preimmersion and surjective on stalks, so its residue-field map is surjective; any field homomorphism is injective. Thus it is an isomorphism. Combine it with the point equality fibreι(asFiber x)=x, apply Spec, and use naturality of fromSpecResidueField and the fibre pullback square to prove the required arrow isomorphism.
